narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The training script sits in a shared directory with no version control. I overwrite the file each week. The previous configuration is gone once the new run starts. I keep a local copy of the hyperparameters in a spreadsheet on my desktop. The evaluation metrics land in a text file next to the script. There is no central log of which model version produced the order suggestions for the northern stores. I cannot retrieve the exact parameters used three weeks ago. The backup is a zip file I created by hand before the last update. The system has no record of model lineage. I replace the code and restart the nightly job. The artifacts exist only on my workstation and in the shared folder.
output.reclassify_reason: The text consists entirely of descriptive statements about the current state of the infrastructure and data management, containing no expressions of desire, refusal, acceptance, or explicit trade-offs.
